title: List the long assignments
prompt: For every assignment of more than 400 hours, return first_name (the employee's), project (the project's name) and hours. Put the most hours first, and sort assignments with the same hours by first_name.
hints: assignments holds two ids. Which tables do they point at?
Join assignments to employees on employee_id, and to projects on project_id.
FROM assignments AS a JOIN employees AS e ON e.id = a.employee_id JOIN projects AS p ON p.id = a.project_id WHERE a.hours > 400

wrongAnswers.misconception: Includes an assignment of exactly 400 hours.
Links projects through the employee id instead of the project id.

feedback: Check each ON condition: one links the employee, the other links the project. Then check the edge at exactly 400 hours.
